## Structural mechanism
Keep a FIFO register of the last three observed tokens. For history length t>=3, let a=x[t-3] and emit f(a) with probability about 0.8; spread the remaining probability diffusely over other symbols. All 2,688 supplied predictions with a delayed parent have argmax f(x[t-3]), without exception.
